preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 500.
The number of roads m must be between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges in a complete graph with n vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi and 1 <= li <= 10**6 for xi, yi, li in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n, and the length of each road must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n * (n - 1) / 2 integers, representing the number of roads on shortest paths for all pairs of cities.

postconditions.expression: all(cst >= 0 for cst in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be non-negative, representing the count of roads on shortest paths.

postconditions.expression: any(cst == 0 for cst in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If there is no path between any pair of cities, the corresponding output value must be 0.
